title: deposit.orphaned
description: The block carrying this deposit was reorged away before it was credited. It may reappear on the canonical chain (deposit.detected again) or expire (deposit.dropped). No ledger entry was ever made.

deposit_id.description: Stable id of the deposit across every event about it.

amount.description: Decimal amount in the asset's own units, never wei.

address.description: The controlled address that received it, lower-case.

log_index.description: Index of the ERC-20 Transfer log, or -1 for a native transfer. Together with tx_hash and the chain it is the deduplication key.

block_number.description: Where it currently sits. A reorg can change this for the same deposit.

confirmations.description: head - block_number + 1 at the time of the event.

status.description: The deposit's status after this event. An open string: a new state must not break a consumer.

required_confirmations.description: The asset's threshold at the time, so progress can be rendered without reading the registry.
